_comment: Copy to config.json (install.ps1 does this for you). Paths are machine-specific; config.json is git-ignored.
_extraVoicesDirs: Extra folders searched for voices, same <sex>/<culture>/<id> layout. For voices you may keep but not publish -- they stay out of this repo entirely.
_watch: Follow session transcripts directly rather than waiting for Claude Code to call the hooks. Works in any client, no restart. Turn off to rely on hooks alone.
_watchCodex: Also narrate local Codex task transcripts with the same TL;DR rule and panel controls. Restart the engine after updating the code.
_historyKeep: How many past utterances keep their audio, so the panel can replay one instantly. They live in %TEMP% and are cleared when the engine restarts.
_engine: Which synthesiser speaks. 'qwen' is the original -- Studio, a GPU, the voices in voices/, and it reads Cyrillic. 'pocket' is Kyutai's Pocket TTS: pip install pocket-tts, runs on the CPU, faster to the first word, and six Latin-script languages only. Takes effect on the next thing said. See docs/engines.md.
_pocketLanguage: Which Pocket TTS model to load: english, french, german, italian, portuguese or spanish. Means nothing to the other engine, and the voice list changes with it.
_voiceByEngine: Who was speaking on each engine, so that switching back and forth does not lose the choice. Written by the tool, not by hand.
_volume: How loud, 0.0 to 1.0. This is Windows' own per-app volume -- the slider the mixer keeps under this app's name -- so it applies in the middle of a sentence, and to replayed audio.
_playback: How much speech is ready before the first word. instant starts as soon as there is anything to start with; buffered banks about fifteen seconds first, so a stall in synthesis is spent from that instead of being heard as a gap; whole makes the entire message and plays it as one file, after which a gap is impossible. Read per message, so it needs no restart. See docs/how-it-works.md.
_updateCheck: Whether it may look for a newer version of itself, at most once every updateCheckDays. Off -- and it is the only thing here that would ever use the network. 'voice_cli.py update' looks when you ask it to, whatever this says, and every contact is written down in logs/update.log. See docs/updating.md.
